content.text: Docs for bumping the pin are in packages/editor-presence/README. Closing.
Editor presence frames and the collab gateway have drifted twice this year — once on the peer color field rename, once when leaseMs became required. Manual QA caught both late.

Add contract tests that load the presence protobuf/JSON schema from the gateway repo as a git submodule pin, generate fixtures, and assert the editor client encoder/decoder round-trips PresenceJoin, PresenceCursor, and PresenceLeave without dropping fields.
Complete when CI fails if the submodule pin advances with a breaking schema change the client has not adapted, and the suite runs under packages/editor-presence in under 8 seconds.
